purpose: Truth-free audit of the single next factor selected by Phase45: raw Android GNSS receiver clock/timing residual. This record fixes inputs, equations, diagnostics, and numeric gates before any Phase46 device_gnss payload is opened.

scope.cohort: The same four Pixel5 development routes used by Phase44/Phase45.
scope.allowed_input: Only the four pinned raw device_gnss.csv files and their raw Android timing/status/measurement fields.
policy_only_pins: Phase45 no-go/residual-identifiability policy and the name of its single next factor
Phase25 raw Android clock contract and Phase37 raw materialization metadata
scope.policy_only_pin_rule: Phase44/Phase45 result values, truth-derived ENU/residuals, candidate scores, and any enriched trajectory are not Phase46 diagnostic inputs.
forbidden_inputs: Phase45 result/residual/ENU payload as a diagnostic input
MAT files, archive reopen, rematerialization, device-WLS columns, precomputed inference coordinates

read_contract.read_accounting: The evaluator reads each pinned CSV once with one byte read, parses that byte buffer once, and records byte count and SHA-256. No route is reopened by tests, diagnostics, or documentation generation.

phase45_policy_freeze.use: metadata/policy pin only; payload is not opened by the Phase46 evaluator

phase25_raw_clock_contract.use: source support for Android raw field semantics and integer segment-base contract

archive.use: provenance pin; archive is not reopened in Phase46

raw_schema.row_filter: Only MessageType=Raw rows are eligible. Other Android message types are counted and excluded without a second file read.
raw_schema.raw_only_rule: Optional enriched position/WLS/pseudorange columns are not parsed as estimator inputs. Pseudorange impact is reported only as c times a raw receiver-TOW difference, with no coordinates or truth.

fixed_clock_equations.gps_hardware_integer_part_ns: integer(TimeNanos) - integer(FullBiasNanos); this subtraction is performed before any floating conversion.
fixed_clock_equations.leap_source_support: The fixed 18-second GPS-UTC offset is the dataset-era Android/GNSS source-supported comparison constant. It is not dynamically looked up and is never inserted into the Phase25 pseudorange equation.
fixed_clock_equations.center_and_drift: For each route, compute the median-centered residual and an ordinary least-squares affine fit against elapsed hardware seconds. Report raw centered p50/p95/max absolute residual and detrended p50/p95/max absolute residual. Drift ppm is 1e6 times affine residual slope (ms/ms).
fixed_clock_equations.long_double_risk: Compare exact integer/Decimal receiver hardware nanoseconds with a float64 evaluation of the same expression; record p50/p95/max absolute difference in nanoseconds. The exact path remains integer arithmetic plus Decimal BiasNanos.

segmentation_and_events.epoch_key: First-seen utcTimeMillis among eligible Raw rows; all rows sharing that key are one epoch.
segmentation_and_events.explicit_segment_boundary: At the first row of an epoch when HardwareClockDiscontinuityCount changes or the preceding epoch's TimeNanos gap is strictly greater than 1000000000 ns. This is the Phase25 segment-base contract; a FullBias change by itself is not silently declared a boundary.
segmentation_and_events.full_bias_change: Every FullBiasNanos change is recorded with its UTC key, HCDC state, TimeNanos gap, and whether it coincides with an explicit boundary. An uncaptured change fails the gate.
segmentation_and_events.time_gap: Record every TimeNanos gap >1 second and the difference between UTC-key and hardware-clock intervals.
segmentation_and_events.clock_fields: Record per-epoch spread and same-epoch satellite clock-field disagreements for TimeNanos, FullBiasNanos, BiasNanos, TimeOffsetNanos, and optional uncertainty/drift fields.
segmentation_and_events.tow_base: Within each explicit segment, use the first valid FullBiasNanos as the segment base; compare exact per-row receiver TOW to that base and retain route/segment median, MAD, spread, and c-scaled metres.
segmentation_and_events.uncaptured_jump: An adjacent-epoch receiver-TOW change not explained by its UTC interval, affine drift, or an explicit boundary is an event. Its non-common-mode effect is the residual within-epoch receiver-TOW spread times the frozen speed of light.
segmentation_and_events.utc_key_integrity: Report nonmonotonic first-seen epoch keys, conflicting duplicate epoch records, inferred missing keys from the route median positive interval, and non-finite intervals. Repeated rows sharing an epoch key are expected satellite rows, not duplicate epochs.

receiver_tow_and_pseudorange: route and explicit-segment base-vs-row receiver-TOW difference
common-mode and non-common-mode c-scaled impact in metres
diagnostics.constellation_signal: For every available constellation and signal, report residual and TimeOffsetNanos distributions, between-group median offsets, and whether same-epoch clock-field differences are common-mode or non-common-mode.
diagnostics.route_aggregate: Report pairwise route-median distances and an aggregate robust median/MAD; no truth, candidate, geometry, or Phase45 residual enters this aggregate.

route_count.criterion: Exactly the four pinned Pixel5 routes are processed once; no route substitution or omission.

raw_input_identity.criterion: Every opened CSV byte count and SHA-256 exactly equals exact_raw_inputs; any mismatch is a hard failure.

all_finite_required_timing.criterion: Every eligible Raw row has finite integer utcTimeMillis, TimeNanos, FullBiasNanos, BiasNanos, HCDC, and every present numeric optional timing field.

raw_epoch_domain_coverage.criterion: Every eligible Raw row is represented exactly once in the first-seen UTC epoch domain; no dropped, extra, or duplicate-conflict row.

utc_key_order.criterion: No nonmonotonic first-seen utcTimeMillis epoch key and no conflicting duplicate epoch record.

detrended_utc_gps_residual_ms.criterion: After the predeclared median center and affine drift fit, every route's maximum absolute residual is <=2 ms; no unexplained residual above 2 ms is permitted.

linear_drift_ppm.criterion: Every route's absolute affine drift is <=1000 ppm.

hcdc_full_bias_boundary_capture.criterion: Every HCDC change and every FullBiasNanos change is captured at an explicit Phase25 segment boundary; changes without that boundary fail.

uncaptured_tow_noncommon_mode_m.criterion: No uncaptured receiver-TOW jump may yield >10 m of non-common-mode c-scaled effect. A pure common receiver-clock gauge is reported but does not satisfy this gate by itself.

base_vs_row_full_bias.criterion: Per-row FullBiasNanos equals the active segment base unless the row is at an explicit boundary; otherwise fail.

decision_policy.go: All hard numeric gates pass and the observed residual has a raw-only, source-supported, geometry-changing clock mechanism that is implementable without truth or a solver rerun.
decision_policy.no_go: Any hard gate fails, or the strongest clock/timing structure is only a common receiver-clock gauge, or no source-supported raw-only geometry-changing clock mechanism is identifiable.
decision_policy.correction_status: Audit only. No clock correction is implemented in Phase46.
decision_policy.next_factor_rule: On no-go, name exactly one next raw physical factor supported by the observed raw structure and source semantics; do not preselect a second factor or implement it.
